verdict.rationale: No native bulk operation is documented. The Registrar API (docs-10) covers searching, checking, registering and managing domains, and the published OpenAPI spec (probe-3) makes it scriptable, so an AI-native user could loop over many domains programmatically. That is a workaround, not first-class bulk support. Missing for 10: documented native bulk actions (e.g. bulk transfer, renew, auto-renew toggle, WHOIS edit or DNSSEC across many domains), batch API endpoints, and hands-on evidence of multi-domain operations.
